daughter of the Rev. Duke Yonge

Eldest child of Rev. Duke Yonge and Cordelia Pode, who were both first cousins of CMY, she married (1886) Dr. Adam William Thorburn Steer, a surgeon, and had one child Cordelia before dying young. [window in Newton Ferrars church; LG Yonge The Times reports a legal case over her life insurance policy (25 July 1896)]
